note: Bibb County AL has no queryable zoning district layer. County GIS (bibbal.com, alabamagis.com/Bibb, FlagshipGIS mobile map) offers parcel search only; no zoning layer found in ArcGIS Online/Hub search. Alabama zoning power sits mainly with municipalities; sources conflict on county zoning. The largest city, Centreville, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (July 2007 version, B-1, M-1, R-1 to R-3, RR districts), with no queryable service found; cityofcentreville.com has no GIS links.
